guide_lib.book.instant_structure.desc: Guides you through exporting and automatically building structures
guide_lib.instant_structure.page.overvie: Instant Structure exports structures to NBT templates and rebuilds them with ghost previews. Marker and Builder work in survival without OP. Export saves directly under config/instant-structure/templates-structure/.
To export, set a selection bounding box by clicking two blocks diagonally with the Structure Marker, and click a 3rd time to open the export menu. Scroll while holding Shift to adjust height, and Shift + Right-click to undo steps.
guide_lib.instant_structure.page.builder: Right-click the Instant Builder to browse templates. No OP required. After selecting a template, right-click once to tentatively lock placement, inspect, then right-click again to confirm. Shift + Right-click to rotate or clear tentative lock.
[Obtain / Config] Default: craft with gold ingots, oak fences, and a compass.\nDisable crafting via Mod settings "Enable Recipes".
guide_lib.instant_structure.page.builder: [Obtain / Config] Default: craft with redstone torches, iron ingots, and a book.\nDisable crafting via Mod settings "Enable Recipes".
guide_lib.instant_structure.page.guide_b: Craft the manual with a book and compass (guide-lib required). It explains marker, builder, and bundled templates.
guide_lib.instant_structure.page.bundled: Bundled house and village templates are vanilla blocks exported from a Minecraft superflat world (auto-generated structures). They are copied into config/instant-structure/templates-structure/ on first launch. You may use and modify them freely in your worlds.
